validator_notes: Canonical repo at github.com/framer/motion. MIT license verified. npm package is 'motion' (import from 'motion/react' for React). 31.9k stars, actively maintained, 1,326 tags. Formerly Framer Motion; renamed to Motion with v11. Default animation layer for the portfolio.

Canonical repo at github.com/greensock/GSAP. npm package is 'gsap' v3.15.0. License is GreenSock Standard 'No Charge' license (https://gsap.com/standard-license) — NOT OSI-approved. Free for nearly all uses including commercial projects as of 2023 Webflow partnership; all formerly premium plugins (ScrollTrigger, SplitText, etc.) are now free. License string in npm registry: "Standard 'no charge' license: https://gsap.com/standard-license." Validator must re-confirm acceptable use for portfolio before ingestion. 24.7k stars, 188 commits, 117 releases.

Canonical repo at github.com/pmndrs/react-three-fiber. npm package is '@react-three/fiber'. MIT license. v9.6.1 released April 28, 2026. 30.8k stars, 2,849 commits, 133 releases. React renderer for Three.js — intended for the one intentional 3D scene in apps/portfolio/.

Canonical repo at github.com/pmndrs/drei. npm package is '@react-three/drei'. MIT license. v10.7.7 as of November 2025. 9.6k stars, 897 releases. Companion helper/abstraction library for @react-three/fiber. Required alongside react-three-fiber for productive 3D scene composition.

Canonical repo at github.com/rive-app/rive-react. npm package is '@rive-app/react-canvas'. MIT license. 1.1k stars, 624 commits. React wrapper around the Rive JS/Wasm runtime. Supports React 16.8 through 19. Intended for state-driven micro-interactions (risk meters, fit gauges). Official docs at rive.app/docs/runtimes/react.

Canonical monorepo at github.com/LottieFiles/dotlottie-web. npm package is '@lottiefiles/dotlottie-react'. MIT license. Most recent release @lottiefiles/dotlottie-vue@0.11.13 on May 8, 2026, indicating active monorepo maintenance. 475 commits. Intended for empty/loading states and section transitions in apps/portfolio/.

Canonical repo at github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis. npm package is 'lenis'. MIT license. v1.3.23 released April 15, 2026. 13.9k stars, 1,054 commits. Lightweight smooth-scroll library with React/Vue support. Optional inclusion for portfolio scroll choreography. darkroom.engineering is the authoritative maintainer.
